name: [COIL + X3] Gunung Malaikat
desc:
Mount Angel is a breathtaking mountain-climbing adventure with an easy difficulty level, perfect for beginner climbers.

Conquer nerve-wracking obstacles on Mount Angel, reach the highest peak, and unlock exclusive climber titles-each title has its own unique aura. The higher you climb, the greater the titles and auras you'll earn!

Key Features in Mount Angel:


✨ Free wings at the summit 
☁️ Sky changer with 15 options 
🤝 Carry up to 8 players 
🏅 Collect climber titles with special Auras 
🏆 Global leaderboard for the best climbers 
🌀 Unique parkour challenges & obstacles 
🌄 Beautiful and stunning mountain scenery 
🔄 Regular updates with new content
